result.title: ParetoRSI-Gym: Can AI Agents Improve Language Models Across Multiple Domains?
result.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires an agentic system to design, train, and evaluate its own successor. Data-driven post-training is a central part of that loop, yet existing evaluations measure it on a single benchmark, where an agent selects from a static pool or distills a stronger model to push one score up in one run. Real post-training is multi-domain, and a gain in one domain has to be weighed against a regression in another. We propose ParetoRSI-Gym, in which an agent searches for data, curates it, trains, reads back per-domain results, and repeats, with everything but the data held fixed: the initial LLM, the five domains (math, code, finance, medicine, science), the toolset, and the SFT pipeline. Generalization benchmarks in each domain separate capability gains from overfitting to the scores the agent optimizes against. Across three agent systems, three base models, five rounds and multiple seeds, the strongest system, Claude Code with Opus-5, raises the generalization scores of its proxy-best checkpoint by 9.2% relative to the starting model (+2.3 absolute points), averaged with equal weight over three base models and five domains, with a single-domain relative gain of up to 63% (medicine on Ministral-3-3B). Further analysis shows that the harness matters as much as the model it drives, and that each agent keeps a unique data selection strategy. We see our work as a step towards evaluation of RSI systems in real-world machine learning engineering.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ParetoRSI-Gym，一个多领域后训练环境，让 agent 自主检索与筛选数据、训练、读取各领域结果并迭代，在固定模型、工具与 SFT 流程下，用各领域泛化基准区分真实能力提升与对优化目标的过拟合。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文的「代理指标提升 vs 泛化增益」分离式评测与多目标权衡，可供核查 LVR 中隐状态监督与轨迹训练是否只在拟合中间指标，而非真正提升推理能力；本身不涉及视觉或多模态 latent 状态。
